plugins.name: zi
plugins.description: Prompt-to-plan helper: interrogate a rough idea into a refined prompt, then draft and independently verify an implementation plan (prompt → plan) — or run prompt → plan → execute one-shot with /zi:task, which relays stage questions to you and commits on pass. Plus an overnight-loop prompt generator, a code locator, a todo registrar (`/zi:todo`), a todo compactor (`/zi:todo-compact`), and git stage/commit helpers.
